escenas.prompt: Static camera. Hot, bright sunny early afternoon on an empty covered lanai. The black ceiling fan with dark wood blades hangs completely still, its blades do not move at all. Sunlight shimmers on the turquoise pool behind the screen enclosure and palm leaves outside sway very gently. No people, no animals. No camera movement.
Floyd lifts his head in his bed.

Static camera, close view of the black camera on the lanai post in bright afternoon sun. Its head pans slowly a little toward the lanai and a tiny status light blinks. Palm leaves sway gently. The camera does not change shape. No people. No camera movement.

Static camera. Bright sunny afternoon on the covered lanai. The tan pit bull lies on the tiles, panting softly. After a moment the black ceiling fan above starts turning, slowly at first and then spinning steadily; the dog's ears lift a little in the breeze and he closes his mouth, relaxed. The fan stays attached to the ceiling and keeps its shape. Only one dog, no people. No camera movement.

Static camera. Bright dental clinic break room in early-afternoon daylight. The woman in light-blue scrubs, seen from behind and the side, holds her phone low and looks down at it, then smiles softly and nods a little. The phone screen is never visible. Her mouth does not move, she does not speak. Palm trees sway outside the window. Nobody else around. No camera movement.

Static camera. Bright sunny afternoon on the covered lanai. The black ceiling fan spins steadily and smoothly above. The tan pit bull lying on the tiles slowly lowers his head onto his paws and closes his eyes, calm and cool. The fan stays attached to the ceiling and keeps its shape. Only one dog, no people. No camera movement.

partes.texto: ¿Para quién prende la casa estos ventiladores?
Daniel y Mariana trabajan. Floyd no.
Su puerta solo se abre para él.
La cámara lo ve con este calor.
Mariana se entera desde la clínica.
Cuando Floyd entre, se apagan solos.
Geo Homes. Tu casa, a tu ritmo.
